say:0:1211110001:0.text: Glimmerblooms? How do they manage to live here?
say:0:1211110001:0.source_cn: 是荧荧花，它们是怎么在这里生存的？

say:1:1211110002:0.text: Cassadee would be interested in researching their habitat.
say:1:1211110002:0.source_cn: 说不定科丝蒂愿意来这里研究它们的生态。
say:1:1211110002:0.male: Cassadee would be interested in researching their habitat.
say:1:1211110002:0.female: Cassadee would be interested in researching their habitat.
